mapper.select: select cust_name, group_id, province_cust_id, cust_state, eparchy_code, b_city_code, first_calling_type_code, case when second_calling_type_code is not null and second_calling_type_code != '' then concat(second_calling_type_code, 'AA') else '' end as second_calling_type_code, third_calling_type_code, case when cust_class_type = '1' then '600' when cust_class_type = '2' then '500' when cust_class_type = '3' then '400' else '' end as cust_class_type, create_date, create_oa_user_code from tf_f_cust_group_d where group_id not in (select hq_grp_code from zqzt_grp_group_info) and date_format(create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') >= date_format(#{createDate}, '%Y-%m-%d 00:00:00') and date_format(create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') <= date_format(#{createDate}, '%Y-%m-%d 23:59:59')
